title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-27
source: flac16 ; Recorded By Mason Taylor on a Nakamichi 550 Cassette Deck, on chrome tapes; Senn 441's>Sony D5>Mason's Nak 550: Transferred on Mason's restored Nak550 properly

ai_review.summary: A Mason tape that clears up mid‑show, delivering a high‑energy Wheel→Other One stretch on an otherwise strong second set.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers note that the recording improves around Peggy‑O and shines in the second set, especially with the blazing Wheel > The Other One sequence. While early portions are a bit muddy, the later sound is clear enough to let the band’s groove shine through, making this a worthwhile listen for fans of that era.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (high‑energy second set, standout Wheel→Other One) while recording quality is described as improving partway through; average of the two reviews (3★ and 4★) adjusted for strong musical performance yields a rating just above 4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early parts of the tape sound muddy; clarity improves around Peggy‑O and is solid through the second set, providing an overall decent listening experience despite initial issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert builds as it progresses, with the first set a bit uneven but the second set delivering strong dynamics and an especially powerful Wheel→Other One jam.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass drives The Other One to “the point of no return,” noted as a highlight.
